This is a quick note on how to handle a connection timeout where deb.parrot.sh error appears when running the apt update command.

In my environment, the problem was resolved by upgrading the ParrotOS system with the sudo parrot-upgrade command.

sudo parrot-upgrade

If this command does not fix the problem, the forum thread in the reference link below may help.

Reference: Cant access deb.parrot.sh - Support / Installation and Configuration - Parrot Community

frontmatter.description: I decided to rebuild my ParrotOS environment, which I use for Hack The Box and CTFs, so I wrote this article as a memo on the setup procedure.
frontmatter.title: How to Fix `deb.parrot.sh error` Connection Timeouts During ParrotOS Updates
